sentences.text: My little lantern saw that the parents' room stayed below 18.0 °C, reaching 16.3 °C at 00:00.
The office also dropped to 16.5 °C at 03:30, and the bathroom was 16.7 °C at 00:00.
Since all these rooms stayed below 18.0 °C, please remember that the WHO recommends at least 18 °C indoors in cold seasons.
Because of these low temperatures, I gently suggest checking the heating system to keep things cozy.
